metadata.question: Was surface water extent higher on February 25, 2019 as compared to February 27, 2014 in the Mississippi River near the Memphis, Tennesse?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- AOI: 20 km buffer around Memphis downtown on the Mississippi River (Point: [-90.05, 35.12]).
- Primary data: Landsat 8 SR (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) within ±3 days; if empty widen to ±10 days; fallback to Landsat 7 SR (LE07/C02/T1_L2).
- Dates: 2014-02-27 and 2019-02-25.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Apply QA_PIXEL mask: remove dilated cloud (bit1), cloud (bit3), cloud shadow (bit4), snow (bit5).
- Scale reflectance (0.0000275, -0.2). Use MNDWI > 0.1 to classify water.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after retries: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either period: C2.
- If any calculation returns null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare water areas: 2019 > 2014 -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers to await getInfo
  const getInfo = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-90.05, 35.12]);
  const geom = center.buffer(20000); // 20 km buffer around Memphis
  const scale = 1000; // per requirement: >= 1000
  const date2014 = '2014-02-27';
  const date2019 = '2019-02-25';

  // 2. Prep and masking
  function prepLandsatSR(image, sensor) {
    const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
    // Mask: dilated cloud (1), cloud (3), cloud shadow (4), snow (5)
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));
    // Scale reflectance
    const scaled = image.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    let green, nir, swir1;
    if (sensor === 'LC08' || sensor === 'LC09') {
      green = scaled.select('SR_B3');
      nir   = scaled.select('SR_B5');
      swir1 = scaled.select('SR_B6');
    } else if (sensor === 'LE07') {
      green = scaled.select('SR_B2');
      nir   = scaled.select('SR_B4');
      swir1 = scaled.select('SR_B5');
    } else {
      green = scaled.select('SR_B3');
      nir   = scaled.select('SR_B5');
      swir1 = scaled.select('SR_B6');
    }
    return ee.Image.cat([
      green.rename('green'),
      nir.rename('nir'),
      swir1.rename('swir1')
    ]).updateMask(mask).copyProperties(image, image.propertyNames());
  }

  function buildCollection(sensor, start, end) {
    const colId = sensor === 'LE07' ? 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2' : 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2';
    const col = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .map(function(img) { return prepLandsatSR(img, sensor); });
    return col;
  }

  async function getCompositeForDate(dateStr) {
    const target = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const windows = [3, 10]; // days
    const sensors = ['LC08', 'LE07']; // primary then fallback
    for (let w of windows) {
      const start = target.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = target.advance(w + 1, 'day'); // inclusive of end day
      for (let s of sensors) {
        const col = buildCollection(s, start, end);
        const n = await getInfo(col.size());
        if (n > 0) {
          const composite = col.median().clip(geom);
          return { image: composite, sensor: s, imgs: n, windowDays: w };
        }
      }
    }
    return { image: null, sensor: null, imgs: 0, windowDays: null };
  }

  async function summarizeWater(img) {
    // Counts: total pixels and valid (non-masked) pixels at scale
    const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones');
    const countingStack = ee.Image.cat([ones, img.select('green')]);
    const countsDict = countingStack.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });
    const totalPix = ee.Number(countsDict.get('ones'));
    const validPix = ee.Number(countsDict.get('green'));

    // MNDWI and water area
    const mndwi = img.expression(
      '(g - s) / (g + s)',
      { g: img.select('green'), s: img.select('swir1') }
    ).rename('mndwi');
    const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0.1);
    const waterAreaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask);
    const waterAreaDict = waterAreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    });
    // Safe extraction: take first value irrespective of band name
    const waterAreaM2 = ee.Number(ee.Dictionary(waterAreaDict).values().get(0));

    const vals = await getInfo(ee.Dictionary({
      totalPix: totalPix,
      validPix: validPix,
      waterAreaKm2: waterAreaM2.divide(1e6),
    }));
    return vals; // {totalPix, validPix, waterAreaKm2}
  }

  try {
    // AOI area
    const aoiAreaKm2 = (await getInfo(geom.area(1).divide(1e6))).toFixed(1);
    console.log(`AOI area km2: ${aoiAreaKm2}`);

    // Get composites
    const comp2014 = await getCompositeForDate(date2014);
    const comp2019 = await getCompositeForDate(date2019);

    if (!comp2014.image || !comp2019.image) {
      console.log(`2014 imgs: ${comp2014.imgs}, 2019 imgs: ${comp2019.imgs}`);
      console.log('At least one period has empty collection after retries.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Summaries
    const sum2014 = await summarizeWater(comp2014.image);
    const sum2019 = await summarizeWater(comp2019.image);

    const tPix14 = sum2014.totalPix || 0;
    const vPix14 = sum2014.validPix || 0;
    const tPix19 = sum2019.totalPix || 0;
    const vPix19 = sum2019.validPix || 0;

    if (vPix14 === 0 || vPix19 === 0) {
      console.log(`2014 validPix: ${vPix14}/${tPix14}, 2019 validPix: ${vPix19}/${tPix19}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking for at least one period.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const water14 = sum2014.waterAreaKm2;
    const water19 = sum2019.waterAreaKm2;

    if (water14 == null || water19 == null || isNaN(water14) || isNaN(water19)) {
      console.log('Water area calculation failed (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const cloudFree14 = (vPix14 / tPix14) * 100.0;
    const cloudFree19 = (vPix19 / tPix19) * 100.0;

    console.log(`2014: ${comp2014.sensor}, ±${comp2014.windowDays}d, imgs=${comp2014.imgs}, validPix=${vPix14}/${tPix14} (${cloudFree14.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2019: ${comp2019.sensor}, ±${comp2019.windowDays}d, imgs=${comp2019.imgs}, validPix=${vPix19}/${tPix19} (${cloudFree19.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Water km2 (2014): ${water14.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Water km2 (2019): ${water19.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Diff km2 (2019-2014): ${(water19 - water14).toFixed(2)}`);

    // Final Answer
    const answer = water19 > water14 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
